args.title: Update README.md with MinIO configuration instructions
args.body:
File: README.md

Add instructions under the 'Running locally' section to set S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 and create the bucket when using MinIO in step 2.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The 'Running locally' section in README.md mentions MinIO as an S3-compatible store option in step 2, but leaves out that S3_ENDPOINT needs to be configured and the bucket created first. Adding these instructions will prevent local setup errors when using MinIO.
